matched_cves.description: Authentication bypass via HTTP header spoofing in AMI MegaRAC BMC's Redfish host interface. Part of the 'BMC&C' vulnerability set disclosed by Eclypsium; affects devices from AMD, Asus, Dell EMC, Gigabyte, HPE, Lenovo, Nvidia, and others using MegaRAC SP-X.
Code injection via AMI MegaRAC's Dynamic Redfish Extension interface, allowing arbitrary code execution as root on the BMC chip. Chains with CVE-2023-34329 for full remote takeover.

lifecycle_flags: Component reached end-of-life on 2024-06-30 - no further security patches expected.
'BMC Firmware' is flagged as a single-source dependency - no qualified alternate vendor on record.
findings_ranked.suggested_mitigation: Patch/upgrade BMC Firmware (AMI) past the affected version range, or isolate on a management-only network segment until patched.
